### Notes

- We have turned the bipartite graph situation into one which approcimates IID sampling. 
- Each observation comes with its own measures as well as the network exposure values 
- It is possible to fully ascertain the measures on included observations 
- It is possible to imagine a super-populaton consisting of individuals independently censored from the sample, but each with fully observed network exposure values since it is a bipartite network and since all places are fully ascertained. 
- In the next section we show how a model like this can be used to coordinate a real outbreak response whetehr it be vaccination or referral for screening, or intensified information.
